title: 第一卷 第10章 执剑会，天地教，青莲宗！
content_zh:
“你不知？”

    陈昭宁一脸惊讶，细细打量陈渊，确定他没有说谎。

    陈渊不动声色地扫了一眼陆承锋，心中疑惑。

    执剑会、执剑人，陆承锋从来没有跟他提过。

    “那你的缚龙搏杀术从何而来？”

    陈昭宁奇怪地问道。

    “在野外拾荒时，从一具尸体上捡到的卷轴。”

    陈渊用铁刺轻轻拨弄火堆，语气漫不经心。

    陈昭宁没有怀疑，微微点头：“原来是这样？嗯，不过，近些年来，大相帝国大肆清剿执剑人，遇到死在外面的执剑人尸体，也正常。”

    陈渊心中一动，问道，“执剑会、执剑人，是什么组织？”

    陈昭宁也不隐瞒，缓缓说道：“在大相帝国里，真正憎恨邪恶、反对兽邪生灵统治天下的，就只有我们人族的复兴组织，执剑会、天地教、以及，青莲宗。”

    人族复兴组织？

    陈渊一怔。

    执剑会！

    天地教！

    青莲宗！

    陈昭宁见他一脸茫然，好奇道：“你不会……连这些都不知道吧？”

    陈渊摇了摇头，和李伟对视一眼。

    两人早已暗中对好了身世的说辞。

    “我们来自一片极遥远的深山，那地方，是世外桃源……日子平淡安稳，娶妻生子，日出而作，日落而息······”

    陈渊开始向陈昭宁，甚至糯米编造身世。

    这话，也是故意说给陆承锋听的。

    陈昭宁和糯米听得一脸向往。

    “真的有这么美好的地方吗？没有压迫，没有邪恶，没有杀戮？”

    陈昭宁轻声问道，美目中异彩涟涟。

    “有的，天外有天。”

    陈渊望向洞口，透过洞口，看向外面昏红的天地，眸光怅然。

    陈昭宁恍然大悟：“说得对，天外有天，这么说来，你们是来自隐世家族？”

    陈渊：“……”

    “嗯？”陈昭宁挑眉，“不对吗？”

    “嗯，对！”陈渊只好点头，继续编道：“我家族的先祖，当年堪称独断万古般的存在，只可惜厌倦了世间纷争，才选择隐世……”

    李伟在一旁听得眼睛发亮，连忙点头附和：“对啊！我们先祖可是先天圣体，天生至尊神骨，他无敌太久，寂寞了，才归隐的！”

    陈昭宁和糯米瞪大了眼睛，像是在听天书。

    “独断万古？先天圣体？天生至尊神骨？”陈昭宁呼吸都微微一滞，目光炙热：“好厉害，好霸道！”

    她上下打量两人，恍然大悟：“难怪，你们身上一点都没有被天地浊气污染的痕迹，原来是世外之人。”

    陈渊和李伟对视一眼，悄悄眨了眨眼。

    陈昭宁目光微敛，轻轻点头：“想必你们和我一样，不甘心一辈子窝在家族里庸碌一生，所以才出来闯荡，对吧？”

    “嗯，正是！”

    陈渊站了起来，负手望天状，故作怅然：“男子汉大丈夫，生于世间，当为天地立心，为生民立命，为人族开太平，怎能蜗居一隅，苟且偷生？”

    “所以我偷偷逃离家族，翻山越岭，来到这片所谓的璀璨大世。”

    “只可惜，差点成了怪物的口粮，哎……”他叹了口气，眸中露出几分沧桑：“还好，被陆大叔救了。”
content_en:
"You don't know?"

    Chen Zhaoning looked surprised and looked at Chen Yuan carefully to make sure he was not lying.

    Chen Yuan glanced at Lu Chengfeng calmly, feeling confused.

    Lu Chengfeng had never mentioned the sword-wielding club or the sword-wielding person to him.

    "Then where did your dragon-binding fighting skills come from?"

    Chen Zhaoning asked strangely.

    "A scroll picked up from a corpse while scavenging in the wild."

    Chen Yuan gently poked the fire with an iron thorn, his tone casual.

    Chen Zhaoning had no doubts and nodded slightly: "So that's it? Well, in recent years, the Prime Minister's Empire has been on a large-scale purge of sword holders. It's normal to encounter the corpses of sword holders who died outside."

    Chen Yuan's heart moved and he asked, "What kind of organization are the Sword Holders Association and the Sword Holders?"

    Chen Zhaoning did not hide anything and said slowly: "In the Prime Minister's Empire, the only ones who truly hate evil and oppose the evil beasts dominating the world are our human race's revival organizations, the Sword Holding Association, the Heaven and Earth Sect, and the Green Lotus Sect."

    Human Race Restoration Organization?

    Chen Yuan was startled.

    Sword-holding meeting!

    Heaven and Earth Sect!

    Qinglian Sect!

    Seeing his confused look, Chen Zhaoning asked curiously: "You don't... don't even know these, do you?"

    Chen Yuan shook his head and looked at Li Wei.

    The two had already secretly agreed on their life experiences.

    "We come from a very remote mountain. That place is a paradise... The life is ordinary and stable, marry a wife and have children, work at sunrise and rest at sunset..."

    Chen Yuan began to fabricate his life experience to Chen Zhaoning and even Nuomi.

    This was also said to Lu Chengfeng on purpose.

    Chen Zhaoning and Nuomi listened with yearning expressions on their faces.

    "Is there really such a beautiful place? No oppression, no evil, no killing?"

    Chen Zhaoning asked softly, his beautiful eyes sparkling with color.

    "Yes, there is a sky beyond the sky."

    Chen Yuan looked at the entrance of the cave, looking through the hole at the dim red world outside, his eyes filled with sadness.

    Chen Zhaoning suddenly realized: "You are right, there is a world beyond the sky. So, you are from a hidden family?"

    Chen Yuan: "..."

    "Huh?" Chen Zhaoning raised his eyebrows, "Isn't that right?"

    "Yes, yes!" Chen Yuan had no choice but to nod and continue to write: "The ancestors of my family were able to be said to be arbitrary for eternity. Unfortunately, they were tired of the strife in the world and chose to live in seclusion..."

    Li Wei's eyes lit up as he listened, and he quickly nodded in agreement: "That's right! Our ancestor was an innate holy body, born with the supreme divine bone. He was invincible for too long and became lonely, so he retired to seclusion!"

    Chen Zhaoning and Nuomi's eyes widened, as if they were listening to heavenly scriptures.

    "Arbitrary for eternity? Innate holy body? Innate supreme divine bone?" Chen Zhaoning's breathing stagnated slightly, his eyes burning: "So powerful, so domineering!"

    She looked at the two of them up and down, and suddenly realized: "No wonder, there are no traces of pollution on your bodies by the turbid air of heaven and earth. You are actually people from outside the world."

    Chen Yuan and Li Wei looked at each other and blinked quietly.

    Chen Zhaoning narrowed his eyes slightly and nodded lightly: "You must be like me. You are not willing to stay in the family and mediocrity all your life, so you came out to make a living, right?"

    "Well, exactly!"

    Chen Yuan stood up, looked up at the sky with his hands behind his hands, pretending to be sad: "A man is born in this world, and he should set his heart for the world, establish his destiny for the people, and create peace for the human race. How can he live in a corner and live an ignoble existence?"

    "So I secretly escaped from my family, crossed the mountains and ridges, and came to this so-called bright world."

    "It's a pity that I almost became a monster's food. Alas..." He sighed, with a hint of vicissitudes in his eyes: "Fortunately, I was saved by Uncle Lu."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 10 Sword Holding Club, Heaven and Earth Sect, Qinglian Sect!
